text:
anya: Quick follow-up from Sparrow postmortem — consolidated action list below. Root cause was repeated VPC peering flaps combined with an on-prem firewall state timeout that dropped connections after reordering. Need owners + short timelines.

miguel: I can take the peering side. I'll build a small harness that replays peer events and verifies routing table convergence. ETA 3 business days.

sophie: I'll do the on-prem firewall review with infra-sre. Plan: audit rules, confirm connection-tracking timeout, and propose a mitigation (reduce CT timeout or pin state). Target end of week.

karthik: FWIW saw the same sequence in logs for two other customers last quarter — pattern looks recurring when peers flapped during large config pushes. Filed TICKET-4382 to track recurrence detection.

anya: Thanks. Two extra asks: 1) add a passive alert for "peer-staged" states so we detect before impact, 2) add a canary route-change window for customers with on-prem peering.

ops-bot: Creating placeholder PR and checklist now -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/runbooks/pulls/1024 :robot_face:

karthik: Diagnostic command I used to correlate events:```bash
aws ec2 describe-vpc-peering-connections --filters Name=status-code,Values=active,deleted,failed 
# then cross-ref with our peering-agent logs: /var/log/peering-agent.log*
```

anya: Action items (short tracker):
- [ ] Owner: miguel - implement peering test harness + automated replay (due 2026-03-30) - PR 1026
- [ ] Owner: sophie - on-prem firewall CT audit + mitigation proposal (due 2026-03-28) - TICKET-4390
- [ ] Owner: anya - runbook updates: peer-staged alert + canary window docs (due 2026-04-02) - PR 1024
- [ ] Owner: karthik - add pattern detection rule & attach historical incidents (due 2026-03-31) - TICKET-4382

miguel: I'll sketch the harness and add a short README on how to run it against customer peering data. Will also add a smoke test hook into the Dedicated deployment pipeline.

sophie: For the firewall change, if we can't get customer approval for CT params, fallback plan is to implement application-side keepalive to keep conn tracked.

anya: Good. For visibility I'll schedule a 15-min sync on Friday (09:30 PT) to close blockers — invite going out now. If anyone can't make it, drop an update here.

incident-bot: Reminder: link all remediation PRs to the incident card (INC-2026) so we have traceability.

karthik: Quick note — recommend adding a regression alert that compares peer-flap cadence (per hour) vs baseline to avoid noisy signals. I'll prototype a query and share. :+1:

miguel: noted. will add a flag in harness to simulate high cadence flaps.

anya: Great work team. Let's aim to close the high-risk items this sprint so Sparrow has the dedicated mitigations in place. :eyes:
